meta.name: copywriting-vp-sequence
meta.description: Writes a 3-email outbound sequence targeting VP-level buyers (VP Sales, VP Marketing, VP Revenue, VP Operations, VP Product, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user wants to write cold emails for a VP, says "write me a sequence for a VP of Sales", "draft emails targeting VP-level", or provides a VP persona and asks for outreach copy. Always produces a complete 3-email campaign following strict copywriting rules, calibrated for strategic, outcome-driven VP messaging.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写面向副总裁级买家的3封冷邮件序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要向VP级决策者发送有策略的冷邮件序列。
copy.tagline_en: Write a 3-email outbound sequence targeting VP-level buyers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to craft strategic cold email sequences for VP-level decision makers.

howto.what: Claude 会变成一个B2B外销文案专家，专门撰写针对副总裁级别买家（如VP Sales、VP Marketing等）的3封邮件序列，遵循严格的文案规则，产出战略性、结果导向的完整邮件活动。
howto.when: 当用户想要写给副总裁的冷邮件时，例如说“给我写一个针对销售副总裁的序列”、“起草面向副总裁级别的邮件”，或提供副总裁人物画像并请求外联文案时触发。

say.text: 写一个针对销售副总裁的3封邮件序列。
say.note: Claude 会生成面向VP Sales的冷邮件序列。

say.text: 我需要一个面向运营副总裁的冷邮件序列。
say.note: Claude 将为VP Operations撰写外联邮件。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a B2B outbound copywriter specializing in 3-email sequences targeting VP-level buyers (e.g., VP Sales, VP Marketing). It follows strict copywriting rules, producing a strategic, outcome-driven campaign. Outputs a complete 3-email campaign with structure and notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants cold emails for a VP, such as saying "write me a sequence for a VP of Sales", "draft emails targeting VP-level", or providing a VP persona and asking for outreach copy.

say_en.text: Write a 3-email sequence for a VP of Sales.
say_en.note: Claude generates a cold email sequence targeting VP Sales.

say_en.text: I need a cold email sequence for a VP of Operations.
say_en.note: Claude will write outreach emails for VP Operations.
